note: RFC 7947 Section 2.2.2.1: "As a route server does not participate in the process of forwarding data between client routers, and because modification of the AS_PATH attribute could affect the route server client BGP Decision Process, the route server SHOULD NOT prepend its own AS number to the AS_PATH segment nor modify the AS_PATH segment in any other way." Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor after c8a7d38c3f changed TestReactorForwardRSEBGPPrepend and f8f7628bdf changed bgp-rs-relay-aspath-transparency.ci. Both changes are the same RFC 8212 Section 3 fixture repair: the unit's non-RS EBGP destination gains an explicit filterless FinalAccept ExportPolicy (and makeRSPeer gives its source the same import/export pair), and the .ci gains a bgp-level filter { import { final accept; } export { final accept; } }. Without them reactorForwardRSSection skips the destination at filterapi.Policy.AcceptsAtEnd (an unconfigured policy returns !external), so the tests dispatched nothing; the policies carry no refs, so hasActiveFilter stays false and the fast path, and the !facts.rsClient prepend branch it reaches, are unchanged. No assertion moved: the unit still requires one dispatch, non-empty rawBodies and a body longer than the input, and the .ci still pins the exact wire bytes, conn=2 (rs-client true) byte-identical with AS_SEQUENCE[65001] and conn=3 (rs-client false) AS_SEQUENCE[65000,65001]. The unit's growth-only assertion remains weaker than an exact path oracle, as recorded before; the exact pair is supplied by the .ci and by TestRelayStoredRouteRSClientPreservesASPath / TestRelayStoredRoutePlainEBGPPrependsLocalAS, with TestReactorForwardRSTransparent proving byte identity for an RS client and checkRouteServerASPath the interop side, all unchanged. Discrimination record re-taken in c8a7d38c3f over the changed unit and verified by ./le rfc discriminate: mutant forward_rs.go::reactorForwardRSSection line 633 '!facts.rsClient' -> false reddens it. Both carriers re-run green (go test -run TestReactorForwardRSEBGPPrepend|TestReactorForwardRSTransparent; ./le test bgp plugin bgp-rs-relay-aspath-transparency). Verdict unchanged.
